summary: Verified client-side video export with audio support. Backend GET /api/course/{project_id}/slides-data correctly returns audioElements with 'src' field (legacy 'url' field fix verified). Backend GET /api/proxy-video proxies HeyGen videos correctly. Backend GET /api/audio/{filename} serves legacy audio narration files. Frontend 'Gerar Video' button works, progress bar shows slide rendering and audio loading. All 17 backend tests passed. Frontend video export flow verified with audio capture.
